sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
In the last book of the Bible, God reveals His plans for the future. God told one of the first disciples of Jesus, a man named John, to write down the vision of the future God gave him.

Jesus promised that He would return. He will bring judgment to the earth. Those who have followed Jesus and believed in His sacrifice for forgiveness will be rewarded with eternity in God’s presence. Those who have rebelled and have not believed in Jesus will face eternal separation from God as judgment. Satan, the enemy of God who tempted Adam and Eve and who exists in the world, will be thrown into the lake of fire as God’s judgment, and this story is from the word of God.
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Revelation 7:9-17
Revelation 21:1-8
Revelation 22:1-7, 22:12-13
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach

These scriptures reveal the final goal of God’s grace: a people from every nation made clean by Jesus, a God who dwells with us and wipes away every tear, a new creation for all who believe in Jesus. All of that, from beginning to end, is God’s gift through Jesus Christ. This is the blessed end to which God's grace has always been moving. It is the hope and promise that we share as we preach the gospel and wait for the return of Jesus.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Thank God for his great salvation and commit to share the gospel with those who’ve yet to hear.
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God loves all people and desires that they know Him. Let’s commit to make disciples among all people.
Matthew 28:19-20
Pray
Let’s praise God for his righteous judgment of sin, for his abundant grace towards those who believe, and for his promise to make all things new!
